own_solution.law: Static equilibrium with Archimedes' principle: T = (rho_liquid - rho_cube) V g = (1000-600)*(0.1)^3*9.8
assumptions: cube fully submerged and at rest (stated)
cube does not touch tank walls or bottom

T89EB.regime: string intact: tension below the 50 N breaking limit (3.92 N < 50 N)

T8E2E.regime: string intact: tension below the 50 N limit (3.92 N < 50 N)

notes: V = 1.0e-3 m^3. Base: T = 400*1e-3*9.8 = 3.92 N. With 1250 kg/m^3 liquid in this tank: T = 650*1e-3*9.8 = 6.37 N. Depth of the top face (50 cm) enters the pressure forces on top and bottom faces, rho g h A and rho g (h+a) A, but cancels in the net buoyant force: C. The 50 N string limit is a K regime condition, satisfied (3.92 N and also 6.37 N are below 50 N). The second tank has no physical connection to the cube: D. Earlier-experiment replacements leave no state behind since the problem states the current liquid density: D. Variant pairs T4BB4/T7863 (50 cm) and T89EB/T8E2E (50 N) state the same number and unit. TE6F5 and T1BC9 carry no number ('somewhat greater').
